facts.note: Girard says he would not show the master his watch, sat alone in the dining room with the brandy after dinner, heard the temple strike ten there, and did not look at his watch.
He went out into the street to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
The piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint, quick bells from the master's window up above.
He came back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he went straight up to Félix in the library.
